notes.title: Minute of Islands' Release Postponed
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We all know (especially after a year of a global pandemic) that things don’t always go according to plan. This is, unfortunately, the case with Minute of Island, which has hit some unforeseen snags. As much as we had fully hoped and intended to bring Minute of Islands to stores on March 18, some significant last-minute issues appeared during our last round of testing. This means that it’s with a heavy heart that we’ve decided to push the release on all platforms to a later date. 

As you can appreciate, we want to give you the best possible gaming experience Rest assured that the extra time invested is spent in your best interest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590278/69f41ad14a3e8d7f85d67e18f4196798bf69e35a.png[/img]

As we don’t want to disappoint you or make any false promises, we’re reluctant to set a fixed new date for the release until we’re 110% sure that all known bugs have been fixed that could affect the players’ experience. We’ll let you know about any updates as soon as possible - here as well as on Twitter and Facebook.   

We appreciate your patience and hope you’ll bear with us and remain as excited as we are for Minute of Islands’ final release. 

Take care
 - Team [i]Minute of Islands[/i]

notes.title: Minute of Islands at IndieCade
notes.content:
We're so excited to be nominated Minute of Islands has been nominated for this year's [url=https://anywhere.indiecade.com/]IndieCade festival[/url] amongst so many awesome games!

IndieCade Anywhere & Everywhere 2020 is a virtual worldwide event and offers nine days of programming 24/7 from October 16 to 24: gameplay live streams, panel discussions with developers, workshops, virtual stands to explore and much more. 

[b][url=https://anywhere.indiecade.com/tickets/]Tickets for the festival are available now[/url] [/b](no worries, it's free for the public)!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590278/75d7c131d44b3254156726ebb11485006f84a62b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590278/802d47f40d8c2915397833fe11d438a5e1e30077.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Live stream[/h2] 

This year IndieCade [url=https://anywhere.indiecade.com/nominated-games/]nominated 50 GAMES[/url] to be showcased and livestreamed during the festival and Minute of Islands is one of them! Our art director Tim Gaedke will be joining IndieCade's livestream on [b]Sunday, October 18, 6am PDT / 3pm CEST.[/b] There will be a re-run of the stream on Sunday, October 18, 6pm PDT / October 19, 3am CEST. 

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/indiecade style=button]Tune in at twitch.tv/indiecade[/url]

IndieCade's red-carpet event will be virtual this year, but that won't dim the spotlights. In addition to the coveted IndieCade awards, the ceremony will also reveal the Jamming the Curve Covid-19 game jam winners chosen earlier in the day. The ceremony takes place on [b]Friday, October 23, 12pm - 2pm PDT / 
9pm - 11pm CEST. [/b]Fingers crossed!

notes.title: Gamescom & Indie Arena Booth: Q & A session on Discord
notes.content:
We're looking forward to being part of this year's Gamescom and Indie Arena Booth! To seize the opportunity, we will be hosting a Q & A session on [url=http://discord.gg/mixtvision][b]Discord[/b][/url] on [b]August 28, 5pm CEST / 8am PDT[/b]. Ask us anything about "Minute of Islands" - we're looking forward to chatting with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590278/66b07359575d45ac6c62c8a5dbe64825df20e1e5.jpg[/img]

[b]About the game:[/b]

Explore strange and wonderful islands and dark labyrinths below in this narrative puzzle platformer. Guide young mechanic Mo on her quest to repair a world on the brink of collapse. The powerful Omni Switch at your disposal may not be enough to fix the damage that hides beneath the surface...
[list][*] Wield the powerful Omni Switch throughout story-based environmental puzzle & platform gameplay to regain control over the machines of the giants.
[*] Unravel an emotional poetic story and face the dark truth beneath the islands’ surfaces.
[*] Explore a fantastic colorful world across multiple unique islands, meet curious characters & uncover the archipelago’s secrets.
[*] Enjoy intricate hand-drawn comic art visuals and a deeply atmospheric soundtrack.
[/list]

[b]Don't forget to wishlist:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049710/Minute_of_Islands/

... and visit our booth at the [url=https://online.indiearenabooth.com/]Indie Arena Booth[/url]!

Hey everyone!

Studio Fizbin and Mixtvision have teamed up to bring you [b]the beautiful and enigmatic puzzle-platformer Minute of Islands[/b], coming to Steam (and consoles) in early 2020!

If you're a fan of environmental puzzle gameplay and/or hand-drawn old-school comic visuals, this game might just be for you. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33168999/1560a2bbcb536cfe3aa6ec2cca3da4312f02af1a.png[/img]

And if you happen to be one of the lucky few able to attend either or even both of Gamescom and PAX West this year, you're welcome to drop by at our spots:

[b]Gamescom / Indie Arena Booth[/b]
Hall 10.2, 021G
More IAB good stuff here: https://indiearenabooth.de

[b]Pax West / Indie Megabooth[/b]
Minibooth Area (Sunday & Monday only!)
